decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority considers that the impact of the proposed development on the amenity of 45 Glenham Drive would be unacceptable because it would lead to a significant and demonstrable loss of outlook and increased sense of enclosure, and therefore, prior approval is required, and the application is refused for the above stated reason.
description:
DESIGN
The design proposes construction of a 6m Rear Extension.
 
The rear extension will be constructed with part flat and part mono-pitched roof and there will be a window, a set of bi-fold doors to the rear facing  the garden and a lantern roof window to the roof.

SCALE
The depth of the rear extension would be no more than 6m with a maximum height of 3.99m and 2.95m at the eaves. 

The open space around the original house would remain 76% of the original open space after the construction of the rear extension which above 50% benchmark. (Approx. Original 172.86m², existing 170.53m² and proposed 132.89m²)

MATERIAL
The finish material of the extension would be external render to match with existing. The roof will be constructed with fibreglass with top coat finish or felt or similar and the window and the door will be White uPVC.

ACCESS
The existing front access will be used to enter the house.

SUMMARY
The design creates harmonious relationship between the existing and proposed forms with its modest scale and proportion, adopting traditional design and using existing matching materials. It also complies with Schedule-2 Part-1 Class-A of the Town and Country Planning Order 1995. Thus humbly request to grant Lawful Development Certificate (proposed use).
